responsibility: This module contains the bootstrapped GNU Modula-2 runtime and support code used to build and run the pge parser-generator tool in the GCC Modula-2 subtree. Its main responsibility is to provide a self-contained execution environment for bootstrapped Modula-2 code: core runtime lifecycle and module dependency management (M2RTS, M2Dependent, M2LINK, UnixArgs, main), exception and fault handling (RTExceptions, M2EXCEPTION, SysExceptions, assertion/debug helpers), memory, string, symbol, and container services (Storage/SysStorage, DynamicStrings, StrLib/StrCase, NameKey, SymbolKey, Lists, Indexing), and layered I/O and host bridging facilities (Glibc/Glibm/wrapc, FIO/IO/StdIO/StrIO/SFIO, termios, environment/args, numeric and floating conversion, network/select wrappers). On top of that runtime base, the module also includes the pge-specific scanner and driver pieces (bnflex, PushBackInput, Scan, Gpge, Output) that read grammar input, analyze it, and emit generated parser output. Distinguishingly, this directory is not the general GNU Modula-2 front end; it is the boot-time support library plus parser-generator executable infrastructure that lets GCC’s Modula-2 components build and execute before the full language runtime is available.
